summary: Assess workplace culture with Schein, OCAI, and practical change planning. Explore the five-day course and review the curriculum.
lede: Organizational culture assessment helps people, culture, and change professionals map workplace norms and connect employee feedback to decisions. Participants practise interpreting OCAI profiles, creating culture maps, and prioritizing interventions with measures for change. Schein’s model and the Competing Values Framework support diagnosis, while digital listening exercises include AI-assisted comment coding with human review.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals responsible for assessing workplace norms, interpreting employee feedback, or guiding organizational culture change.
modules: Culture Mapping with the Cultural Web
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Familiarity with organizational structures, employee or team practices, and basic survey or feedback processes is useful. No coding or programming is required. Bring a laptop if you plan to work with Microsoft Excel or Power BI; access to those products is not included or assumed.
